A farm that captures 81 seats hence pays for 81 identities yet holds roughly one seat's influence, as its own consistency is what gives it away. Jurors whose votes correlate above 41% with each other have their weight reduced toward a single shared vote, and the correlation is computed over a window of epochs rather than per case. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
